manual_seasonal_period_policy: Manual seasonal_naive_m{m} for integer1..120 uses same algorithm and explicit period;only m12 is a NOAA benchmark candidate.
numeric_contract: Plain finite decimal strings,<=64characters,<=30integer and24fraction digits;Fraction internal values. Exact fractions serialized with12-place HALF_EVEN decimal displays. RMSE retains exact rational radicand and80-digit Decimal square root rounded to12places. No float conversion of input.
metric_contract: Per-cell scaled absolute error uses each origin training-only seasonal mean absolute difference. Aggregate MASE averages defined per-cell scaled errors with separate denominator;never divide aggregate MAE by average training scale. Bias actual-forecast. Paired candidate-minus-snaive MAE and ratio use common eligible cells;reference zero ->null ratio.
metric_limits: Optional exact absolute-sMAPE only for at most20manual scored pairs;benchmark omits it to avoid impractical denominator growth. Manual quantile/interval reference scoring is supported;no intervals are generated by point models.

selection.rule: Validation per-series macro MAE only;complete forecast coverage required. Test diagnostics never select.

paired_seasonal_naive.direction: Negative MAE difference or ratio<1 favors candidate;comparison limited to common eligible cells.

primary_result: Validation selecteddrift. Test MAE2.537249963267ppm vs seasonal-naive2.1794ppm;ratio1.164196551008. Selected model underperformed on test and is not replaced by the diagnostic test winner.
horizon_evidence: All candidate/horizon MAE/RMSE/bias and eligible counts in full report and benchmark-summary;not hidden by aggregate scores.
dependence: Forecast windows overlap;300cells/model/partition represent36distinct NOAA target months,not300independent trials. No naive significance tests.
vintage: Retrospective evaluation on a fixed revised data snapshot. QC/calibration/midmonth corrections and2022–2023Maunakea substitution;historical publication vintages unverified. Prefix isolation does not prove historical source availability.

resource_evidence.cold_definition: First core read(benchmark) in this fresh measurement process after imports;OS caches not flushed.
resource_evidence.warm_definition: Median of3repeat core read(benchmark) calls in same process;each performs every model/fold again,no forecast cache.
resource_evidence.cli_definition: Fresh python -m future process,including interpreter/imports,core evaluation,JSON serialization and stdout capture;not a machine-cold disk-cache claim.
resource_evidence.memory_method: Windows GetProcessMemoryInfo native peak working set for helper and20ms CLI samples;Linux VmHWM/resource fallback. Native peaks retain prior spikes;CLI last-exit interval can be missed.
resource_evidence.thread_policy: Single calling Python thread;no BLAS/neural/GPU model execution. Parent monitor thread only collects CLI output.
resource_evidence.limits: Measured on this machine only;timings/resource costs are frozen evidence,not universal performance guarantees.

resource_measurement_policy: Offline CPU pure arithmetic;no optional model libraries. Resource evidence measured separately,frozen and referenced by hash;timings excluded from deterministic calculation.

future_target_sentinels.provenance_note: Changing future values changes full dataset/request hashes and outcomes;does not change forecasts from unchanged prefixes.

source_rights: Facts-only original methodological notes;no textbook corpus,figures or implementation copied. NOAA numerical subset retains attribution/public-domain policy. No Chronos assets acquired.
